reply: Thank you for explaining that accounts you have disputed several times are still on your credit report and that this is causing real hardship. We are sorry this has not been resolved. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send a dispute that names each account and explains why it is inaccurate, with copies of any supporting documents, and keep proof of the date it was received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for listing several accounts on your credit report with balances you believe are reported incorrectly. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain for each account which balance is wrong and what it should be, and include statements or payment records that show the correct figures. If you disagree with the results, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $200.00 collection account appeared on your mother's credit report for a service she never signed up for. We understand your concern that this may be identity theft. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the account with the credit reporting company and the company that supplied it, explaining what is wrong and including copies of supporting documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that accounts, inquiries and personal information you do not recognize appear on your credit report, and that creditors have not explained them. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Accounts can appear under unfamiliar names if they were sold or sent to collection, so please dispute each item you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you are a victim of identity theft and that accounts opened by someone else appear on your report. We understand how unsettling this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please report the theft through the federal identity theft website, close any affected accounts, and send the resulting report with your disputes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that inaccuracies on your credit report remain after many requests and are affecting your opportunities and well-being. We are sorry this has been so difficult. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list the specific items you dispute with the reason for each, and keep copies of your past requests. If you disagree with a result, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collection, a personal loan and several inquiries from identity theft appear on your credit report, and that you have filed a report with the Federal Trade Commission. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send the Identity Theft Report and your list of items to block, and review your credit reports again after the review to confirm the changes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your concerns about the privacy of your information and the accounts listed in your attachment. We understand you want to know why they are reported. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please identify each account and explain whether you believe it is not yours or is inaccurate. Credit reports can be shared only with those who have a permissible purpose. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that items on your credit report are inaccurate and should not be reported. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each item and explain why it is wrong. If a company finds it sent wrong information, it must tell every credit reporting company it reported to. Keep copies of your disputes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your account is still linked to a fraudulent email and phone number, so you cannot regain access, even with a security freeze in place. We understand the urgency. Your complaint has been logged for review by the security team, including updating your contact details. Please keep your identity theft report handy and ask for written confirmation once your correct details are on file. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you disputed several accounts with all three credit bureaus and have not received responses or results. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep proof of the dates your disputes were sent and received, and list each account with the reason it is inaccurate. You can request a reinvestigation if you disagree with a result. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that late payment entries remain on your report despite your documents and follow-ups, and how draining this has been. We are sorry it has gone on so long. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each late payment you dispute with the account and month, and include proof of payment. Checking for other common errors can also help. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent a detailed dispute with an affidavit and ID to all three bureaus and have not received responses or a method of verification. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep proof of the delivery dates and copies of what you sent, and ask in writing how each item was verified. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a late payment on your report does not reflect your record of paying on time. We understand why you want it corrected. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the entry with each credit reporting company and the creditor, and include proof of when the payment was made. Wrong payment status is a common error to check for. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that items you have disputed three times remain on your credit report without written verification. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list the disputed items with the reason each is incomplete or inaccurate, and ask for the results and verification in writing. You can request another reinvestigation if you disagree. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about mistakes in your credit report, including personal information, that may have affected your applications. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please check for identity errors such as a wrong name or address and for accounts that are not yours, then dispute each one with supporting documents. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that your personal information, including your Social Security number, was exposed in a data breach and that you want your full consumer file. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. You can request a copy of your file and review it for any accounts or inquiries you do not recognize, and consider placing a security freeze. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that several accounts on your report appear incomplete or inaccurate. We understand you want them reported correctly. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please explain for each account what is incomplete or wrong, and include any supporting documents. If you disagree with the investigation result, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a late payment is reported on your account even though you were on autopay and believe a processing error caused it. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please gather your autopay confirmation and bank records for that month. Statements must be sent at least 21 days before the due date, so note when yours arrived. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you found several inaccuracies in accounts, inquiries and personal information on your consumer report. We understand the distress this is causing. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each item and the reason it is wrong, and include copies of supporting documents. If you disagree with the outcome, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about hard inquiries you did not authorize and that you have an identity theft report. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send your identity theft report with a list of the inquiries, and close or contact the fraud departments of any affected accounts. Keep copies of everything you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a repossession on an account you never opened appears on your credit report, despite your identity theft report and documents. We understand how damaging this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the entry with each credit reporting company and the company that supplied it, and include copies of your identity theft report and ID. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that you have mailed several dispute letters and have not received a response. We understand how frustrating that is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send future letters with tracking so you have proof of delivery. While a dispute is being investigated, it is marked on your report. Keep copies of every letter. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that one credit bureau deleted an account after investigation, but the other two still report it. We understand why this seems inconsistent. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the account with the other two bureaus and include the letter showing it was deleted elsewhere. If you disagree with their results, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for disputing late payment dates on several accounts in your credit file. We understand you believe they are reported incorrectly. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please list each account with the month you dispute and include proof of on-time payment. If you disagree with the result of the investigation, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a late payment on your report is incorrect because you have always paid on time. We understand why you want it changed to on time. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please send proof of the payment date for the month in question with your dispute. If you disagree with the result, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your card autopay was cancelled without notice when you closed an unrelated checking account, causing missed payments, and that a correction was later reversed. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep the autopay confirmations, bank statements and call transcript, and confirm your autopay settings now. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an account on your report shows blank fields and a high balance above the credit limit, which you believe is incomplete. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute the specific fields you believe are wrong or missing and include any statements you have. You can request a reinvestigation if you disagree with the result. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that accounts, inquiries and personal information from identity theft appear on your credit report, and that you have sent ID and proof of address. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please also report the theft through the federal identity theft website and include that report, since it supports a request to block the items. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us about credit inquiries made with your information that you did not authorize. We understand your concern that someone is misusing your identity. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please dispute each inquiry in writing, and if you believe your identity was stolen, report it through the federal identity theft website and consider a security freeze. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
